decision: Outreach design §2 and owner decisions P2/P5/P8 (2026-10-19), outreach slice 3: the purposes proactive outreach may use. Trusted configuration: a new purpose (including a plan-defined one) is a new version of this file; versions are only extended, never edited. The owner enables or disables a listed purpose for the tenant (nexloop.outreach_purposes.set:1); default_enabled applies until then. No purpose needs approval by default (P5; approval is slice 6). Marketing purposes follow the tenant consent mode unless requires_consent (opt-in for that purpose); they carry the server-appended unsubscribe notice and count against the marketing allowance. v2 (owner 2026-10-21, NX-043 X1 review 2.3): renewal_reminder is a marketing purpose - marketing kind and topic, the marketing frequency class and allowance, opt-in consent even when the tenant is opt-out, the unsubscribe notice; it is therefore never an experiment lever. v1 stays as published.
